title: Countable disjoint Borel refinement of a local open cover (Lindelöf)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P (Euclid P) be any set, and let p be any property of subsets of ℝ^P. Suppose every x ∈ U lies in an open set W ⊆ ℝ^P with x ∈ W, W ⊆ U and p(W). Then there are a countable index type ι (ι : Type with Countable ι; ι may be empty) and families (W_i)_{i∈ι}, (A_i)_{i∈ι} of subsets of ℝ^P with the following properties: every W_i is open, W_i ⊆ U and p(W_i) holds; every A_i is a Borel set with A_i ⊆ W_i; the A_i are pairwise disjoint; and ⋃_i A_i = U.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (p : Set (Euclid P) → Prop), (∀ x ∈ U, ∃ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W ∧ x ∈ W ∧ W ⊆ U ∧ p W) → ∃ (ι : Type) (_ : Countable ι) (W A : ι → Set (Euclid P)), (∀ i, IsOpen (W i)) ∧ (∀ i, W i ⊆ U) ∧ (∀ i, p (W i)) ∧ (∀ i, MeasurableSet (A i)) ∧ (∀ i, A i ⊆ W i) ∧ Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (A i) (A j)) ∧ ⋃ i, A i = U
